visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing a black hoodie and pants, walks through an airport on a moving walkway, pulling a silver aluminum Rimowa-style suitcase. The lighting is bright and modern, showing the airport terminal's interior with high ceilings and blurred passers-by in the background. (2) Sitting on a grey airport bench with a large window behind him showing planes on the tarmac, the man speaks to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He rests his hand on the silver suitcase and then opens its top-loading lid to reveal the packed contents. (3) The man reaches into the suitcase and pulls out a black fabric pouch with "BALMAIN PARIS" printed in white. He opens it to show a small white plastic case containing several triangular and rectangular makeup sponges, holding them close for an insert shot. (4) He presents a gray bottle of Jung Saem Mool Men Slim Fit Cover Lotion and a beige tube of Kai Beauty Blurring Face Primer. He holds these grooming products up towards the camera lens for clear visibility, emphasizing the packaging. (5) Next, he retrieves a black Rimowa toiletry bag, displaying various personal care items including dental floss, a green Dentiste toothbrush case, and a small box of eye drops. He handles the objects with his right hand while holding a small lapel mic in his left. (6) The man shows a soft gray wool scarf, rubbing it against his face to demonstrate its softness and then wrapping it around his neck. He closes his eyes and smiles, conveying a sense of comfort and warmth against the background of the airport gate. (7) He holds up a black Leica Q3 camera, showing its front lens and then turning it slightly to display the body. The camera has a black strap attached, which he holds up briefly for the viewer to see. (8) Reaching into the suitcase again, he pulls out a small white plush teddy bear. He hugs the bear closely and smiles warmly at the camera, showing a personal, sentimental item he carries on his travels. (9) Finally, he places the items back, sits back on the bench, and summarizes his travel essentials. He smiles at the camera as the suitcase sits partially open beside him, with the airport background still visible.
